# SotuRail

SotuRail is a local-first, agent-native engineering control plane for AI-assisted software development.

The AI agent is the semantic worker: it understands intent, requirements, ambiguity and project meaning. SotuRail supplies portable Skills and self-describing capabilities, then owns deterministic engineering state such as workspace identity, provenance, freshness, recorded evidence, policy and readiness.

Core rule:

```text
AI understands.
SotuRail organizes, constrains and proves.
```

SotuRail is not a coding agent, model gateway, cloud backend or autonomous shell runtime.
